reference.source: BEIR BM25 (Anserini, k1 0.9, b 0.4, title and text fields)

notes: One abstract per memory as '<title>. <text>' (BEIR indexes two fields); k 100, no token budget; English only. bm25-postings takes its candidates from the postings of the query forms it reads; when a query's readable postings pass POSTING_BUDGET (10,000) it leaves out the forms held by more than 10% of the readable rows, so a row holding only those is no candidate, and below the budget it reads every form and ranks as bm25 (ADR-0052 d6).
